earn.developer: Granted by an admin to people who work on Chordia itself.
earn.staff: Granted by an admin to people who help run this instance.
earn.early_bird: Have an account created before this instance's cutoff date. There is nothing to sign up for; if you were here, you have it.
earn.early_supporter: Be one of the first hundred accounts to ever start a paid subscription. Ranks are never reissued, so a rank that is taken is taken forever.
earn.sonic: Subscribe to Sonic. The badge lasts as long as the subscription does.
earn.super_sonic: Subscribe to Super-Sonic. The badge gains a ring at three, six and twelve unbroken months.

noHistory.tooFew: Nobody has earned this yet, so there is nothing to plot.
noHistory.untracked: Not plotted. A subscription badge records when its holder's current streak began, which moves if they lapse and come back, so past totals cannot be recovered. Drawing a line here would mean inventing one.
